Hi Alice / Procurely team,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To make the vendor setup & PO path smooth, can we do a 30-minute sync early next week to walk through the items below? I want to make sure procurement has everything to issue a PO and finance can set up invoice routing.

What we propose to cover:
- Who will be the primary billing contact and remit email
- Tax forms & legal entity confirmation (W-9 or equivalent)
- Invoice format, PO number placement, and payment terms (Net30/Net45)
- Security evidence / SOC 2 point-of-contact (basic request)
- Expected regular cadence for invoicing and any EDI/portal needs

Attached is our standard vendor onboarding checklist (PDF) — if you can start with the highlighted items (company legal name, EIN, remit address, W-9) that would shorten setup time.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Mon 10/12 10:00–10:30
- Mon 10/12 14:00–14:30
- Tue 10/13 09:00–09:30

If none of these work, suggest two slots and we will accommodate. Vanessa and Marcus are looped for procurement and billing details.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
